categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Shuangyuan Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two core business segments: online automated measurement and control systems, and machine vision intelligent inspection systems. These segments provide solutions for quality detection and control in production processes, serving industries such as new energy batteries, films, non-woven fabrics and sanitary materials, and papermaking.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including X/β-ray sensor detection, microwave moisture detection, embedded high-speed data processing, closed-loop control algorithms, high-speed line scan cameras based on FPGA, multi-channel data fusion, and AI-driven defect classification algorithms. Production follows an order-driven model with customized design, in-house mechanical design, and assembly, supported by rigorous quality control and on-site installation and debugging.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading enterprises in the new energy battery sector (including lithium battery manufacturers), film, non-woven fabric and sanitary material industries, and papermaking. The company also serves emerging markets such as automotive assembly, semiconductor wafer inspection, and food packaging, with a strong focus on industrial automation and intelligent manufacturing sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's sales are predominantly domestic within China, with expanding international presence in countries including Vietnam, Indonesia, Malaysia, and Turkey. The headquarters and main production base are located in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shuangyuan Technology operates primarily as a midstream supplier, providing both core components (such as sensors and cameras) and integrated systems for quality detection and control. The company is evolving from a system supplier to also being a core component supplier, enhancing its control over upstream technologies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment to enhance product intelligence and performance, focusing on AI algorithm development, high-precision sensors, industrial line scan cameras, and embedded vision systems. Strategic R&D projects include AI defect classification on FPGA, 3D CT imaging for internal defect detection, and development of standardized cameras based on domestic FPGA chips. The company also plans to expand into semiconductor wafer inspection and other high-tech fields.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of customized equipment and systems, including online automated measurement and control systems, machine vision inspection systems, and related system components and maintenance services. The company employs a staged payment model based on order signing, delivery, acceptance, and warranty periods.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the machine vision sector, major competitors include international firms such as Isra Vision AG and Wintriss Engineering Corporation, as well as domestic companies like Tianzhun Technology and Jingce Electronic. Shuangyuan Technology's products are positioned at an advanced level, with performance parameters close to leading global competitors. In process control, the company competes with established foreign brands like Honeywell and ABB but benefits from strong domestic market penetration and growing technological capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 429.2 million, a 15.46% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 133.46 million, up 38.33%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 2.78 billion, with net assets attributable to shareholders at RMB 2.18 billion, reflecting rapid growth and expansion following its 2023 IPO. R&D expenditure accounted for 7.43% of revenue, indicating strong investment in innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shuangyuan Technology differentiates itself through its dual-core technology platforms integrating online automated measurement and control with machine vision inspection, offering comprehensive, intelligent, and customized quality detection and control solutions. The company emphasizes high precision, real-time closed-loop control, AI-enhanced defect detection, and strong integration capabilities, enabling customers to improve production quality and efficiency while reducing operational costs. Its ability to provide integrated solutions and core component self-development enhances product reliability and cost competitiveness.
